References:
   1. 300-USNRC-122 Submittal of SMR-300 Instrumentation and Control Architecture
      Licensing Topical Report (ADAMS Accession No. ML25345A240)
   2. U.S Nuclear Regulatory Commission (2026, March 25). Audit Plan for the Staff
      review of the SMR (Holtec) Instrumentation & Control Architecture Licensing
      Topical Report for the SMR-300 Design (ADAMS Accession ML26072A027)

The purpose of this letter is to provide the response to NRC audit question 59 for NRC staff
review.

By letter dated December 11, 2025 (ML25345A240), SMR, LLC, a Holtec International
Company (Holtec), submitted the licensing topical report (LTR) “SMR-300 Instrumentation
and Control Architecture” HI-2251395 Revision 0 (Reference 1) to the U.S Nuclear
Regulatory Commission (NRC). The NRC accepted the LTR for review and issued the
audit plan (Reference 2).

Enclosure 1 contains the proprietary version of the audit question and response. Enclosure
2 contains the non-proprietary version of the audit question and response.

Holtec requests that Enclosure 1 be withheld from public disclosure in accordance with the
Affidavit provided in Enclosure 3.

If you have any questions or require any additional information, please contact Jacob
Dolecki, Senior Manager – Licensing & Engineering Programs, SMR, at
jdolecki@holtec.com, 856-559-3783.
